description: This file defines a PHP class 'Ip' that manages fraud IP addresses within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for installing/uninstalling the database table, adding/removing IPs, and retrieving IP data.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: A model class for managing fraud IP addresses, including database operations for adding, removing, and retrieving IP records.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'fraud_ip' table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'fraud_ip' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Inserts a new IP address into the 'fraud_ip' table with the current timestamp.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Deletes an IP address from the 'fraud_ip' table.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of IP addresses from the 'fraud_ip' table.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total count of IP addresses stored.

methods.name: getTotalIpsByIp
methods.description: Returns the count of entries matching a specific IP address.
